title: Adaptive Asset-Backed Token Systems with Infrastructure-Coupled Supply Elasticity

detail.title: Adaptive Asset-Backed Token Systems with Infrastructure-Coupled Supply Elasticity
detail.abstract: This paper introduces and formalizes a mode-adaptive infrastructure-linked financial instrument governed by deterministic state-transition logic and hybrid valuation anchoring. Unlike conventional equity or debt instruments whose structural behavior is fixed ex ante, the proposed Mode-Adaptive Financial Unit (MAFU) enables state-dependent payout transformation-operating in dividend-distribution mode or dynamic-yield mode-while maintaining supply elasticity strictly coupled to physical infrastructure modification events. The architecture integrates infrastructure state variables as financial drivers and defines a deterministic mint/burn mechanism triggered by audited changes in net asset value (NAV). To incorporate market price discovery without inducing reflexive instability, supply adjustment is anchored to a hybrid valuation function combining NAV and market trading price, moderated by a bounded deviation dampening function. Stochastic simulation modeling demonstrates bounded supply growth, controlled contraction under impairment, and resilience to speculative shocks. Extending prior work on income dominance and CVaR-based resilience modeling, this study formalizes the structural architecture underlying adaptive real-asset financial systems and defines a new class of adaptive real-asset financial instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了一种模式自适应基础设施关联金融工具（MAFU），该工具通过确定性状态转换逻辑和混合估值锚定进行治理，能够根据基础设施状态在分红模式和动态收益模式之间转换，同时保持供应弹性与物理基础设施修改事件严格耦合。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种能够根据基础设施状态自适应调整支付模式和供应弹性的金融工具，同时保持估值稳定性和抗投机冲击能力？
AI.motivation: 传统股权或债务工具的结构行为在事前固定，无法根据基础设施的实际状态变化进行动态调整。现有金融工具缺乏与物理基础设施状态变化的直接耦合机制，导致估值与实物资产脱节，容易受到投机冲击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 模式自适应金融理论：金融工具可以根据状态变量在不同操作模式间转换；2. 混合估值锚定理论：结合NAV和市场价格的混合估值函数；3. 供应弹性耦合理论：金融工具供应与物理基础设施修改事件严格耦合；4. 收入主导和CVaR韧性建模的扩展。
AI.method: 1. 形式化架构设计：定义MAFU的确定性状态转换逻辑；2. 混合估值函数开发：结合NAV和市场价格的锚定机制；3. 确定性铸造/销毁机制：基于审计后的NAV变化触发；4. 随机模拟建模：验证供应增长边界、减值下的受控收缩和抗投机冲击韧性。
AI.findings: 随机模拟显示：1. MAFU能够实现有界的供应增长；2. 在减值情况下能够实现受控的供应收缩；3. 对投机冲击具有韧性；4. 混合估值锚定机制能够在不引发反射性不稳定的情况下纳入市场价格发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化了自适应实物资产金融系统的结构架构；2. 定义了新型自适应实物资产金融工具类别；3. 扩展了收入主导和CVaR韧性建模理论；4. 提出了模式自适应金融工具的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为基础设施融资提供了新型金融工具；2. 实现了金融工具与物理基础设施状态的直接耦合；3. 提供了抗投机冲击的金融工具设计；4. 为实物资产证券化提供了新的技术方案。

title: Agriculture May Date Back 250,000 Years: New Mathematical Modelling Challenges Archaeological Consensus

detail.title: Agriculture May Date Back 250,000 Years: New Mathematical Modelling Challenges Archaeological Consensus

detail.abstract: Archaeology and History generally assume premises that are not adequate representations of observable reality, and this leads to certain incorrect interpretations and improbable conclusions. It is commonly held that Agriculture arose between 12,000 BC and 8,000 BC, with some recent evidence that it was already practised in Israel in 23,000 BC. Yet these conclusions rest upon naïve analyses and naïve interpretations of certain findings, neglecting important statistical and psychometric facts that lead to very different conclusions. When a rigorous and deep Bayesian analysis is undertaken, one arrives at very different conclusions. The dynamics of the creation, sharing, and transmission of knowledge are very different when one considers homogeneous populations (the traditional version) and normally distributed populations (reality). For this reason, it is possible, and even probable, that agricultural techniques were already mastered more than 250,000 years ago. Our thesis may be summarised as follows: if the oldest trace of a technology occurred at T*, this should not be interpreted as though the creation of that technology occurred at time T*, nor even close to time T*. It is far more probable that it occurred at a time T, long before T*. The correct analysis should be: at what moment in history did the cumulative number of adult persons exceed the number N, such that (N-1)/N=G(k+G^-1[1/ph)], where G is the Gaussian-ogive CDF function and G-1 is the inverse function of G, ph is the “typical population of human groupings” at instant T*; k is the maximum number of standard deviations that may separate the intellectual level of the creator of an innovation from the intellectual level of its disseminators in subsequent generations, measured in population-rarity terms, such that the disseminators are able to understand sufficiently to preserve and perpetuate mastery of that technology.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了考古学和历史学关于农业起源的传统观点，通过贝叶斯统计分析指出农业技术可能早在25万年前就已掌握，而非传统认为的1.2万-8千年前。
AI.research_question: 农业技术最早是在何时被创造出来的？考古发现的最早技术痕迹是否代表该技术的创造时间？
AI.motivation: 传统考古学和历史学对农业起源时间的假设存在缺陷，基于朴素分析得出的结论忽视了重要的统计和心理测量事实，导致对技术起源时间的错误解读。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯统计分析、高斯-ogive累积分布函数、知识创造与传播的动态模型、正态分布人口假设（vs传统同质人口假设）
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯分析方法，考虑人口正态分布特征，建立数学模型：当累积成年人口数N满足(N-1)/N=G(k+G^-1[1/ph])时，技术可能已被创造，其中G为高斯-ogive CDF函数，ph为T*时刻的典型人类群体规模，k为创新者与传播者智力水平的标准差最大分离数。
AI.findings: 农业技术很可能在25万年前就已经被掌握，而不是传统认为的1.2万-8千年前。考古发现的最早技术痕迹时间T*远晚于该技术实际被创造的时间T。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了技术起源时间分析的新理论框架，挑战了考古学中"最早痕迹即创造时间"的朴素假设，引入了人口统计学和心理测量学因素来更准确地估计技术起源时间。
AI.practical_contributions: 为考古学家和历史学家提供了更严谨的分析工具，有助于重新评估人类技术发展的时间线，对理解人类文明演进有重要启示。

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Doctrine of Temporal Architecture in System Formation, a structural framework identifying the organization of time—not merely as duration, but as decision density within bounded intervals—as a governing variable in the coherence of complex systems. Introducing Temporal Architecture as a governing variable in system formation, bridging legislative design, doctrinal architecture, and artificial intelligence systems, the doctrine addresses a critical gap in existing scholarship. While institutional fragmentation is commonly attributed to political compromise, bureaucratic inefficiency, or organizational inertia, these explanations fail to account for a more fundamental condition: the manner in which temporal compression is structured across actors during system formation.

The doctrine advances a central distinction between Distributed Temporal Compression (DTC) and Concentrated Temporal Compression (CTC). Under DTC, decision density is dispersed across multiple actors, as exemplified by legislative institutions such as the United States Congress. This structure preserves legitimacy, representation, and shared responsibility, but produces coherence through negotiation, often resulting in fragmentation and policy drift. Under CTC, decision density is localized within a unified architectural process—typically a single author or tightly integrated group—enabling the simultaneous resolution of interdependencies and the production of systems with high internal coherence, cross-domain compatibility, and structural clarity.

Building on this bifurcation, the paper identifies a Structural Tradeoff Principle: systems cannot simultaneously maximize distributed cognitive burden and unified coherence without the introduction of transitional architecture. To address this constraint, the doctrine proposes a Transitional Coherence Layer (TCL)—an intermediary framework designed to preserve system integrity as high-coherence architectures are translated into distributed institutional environments across policy, legislation, and implementation.

The implications of this framework extend across multiple domains. In legislative reform, the doctrine reframes fragmentation not as failure, but as a structural consequence of distributed temporal compression, suggesting the necessity of pre-designed coherence prior to legislative adoption. In the context of war authorization, the doctrine clarifies the tension between distributed moral burden and concentrated strategic coherence, particularly under conditions of crisis-induced temporal compression. More broadly, the framework applies to institutional design across governmental, corporate, and international systems, as well as to emerging domains such as artificial intelligence, where centralized and distributed decision models must be reconciled.

By formalizing Temporal Architecture as a variable in governance theory, this paper provides a unifying explanation for the divergence between institutional legitimacy and system coherence. It further establishes that durable governance depends not on privileging one structure over the other, but on understanding—and structurally bridging—the relationship between distributed and concentrated forms of system formation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"系统形成中的时间架构学说"，将时间组织（决策密度在有限区间内的分布）作为复杂系统一致性的关键变量，区分了分布式时间压缩和集中式时间压缩，并提出了过渡一致性层来解决两者之间的结构性权衡。
AI.research_question: 时间架构（特别是决策密度在有限时间区间内的组织方式）如何影响复杂系统的形成和一致性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将制度碎片化归因于政治妥协、官僚效率低下或组织惯性，但这些解释未能考虑系统形成过程中跨行为者的时间压缩结构这一更根本的条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间架构学说，包括分布式时间压缩（DTC）和集中式时间压缩（CTC）的区分，以及结构性权衡原则。
AI.method: 理论框架构建和概念分析，通过立法机构（如美国国会）和集中式系统设计等案例进行说明。
AI.findings: 1. DTC分散决策密度，保持合法性和代表性，但导致碎片化；2. CTC集中决策密度，产生高内部一致性和跨领域兼容性；3. 系统无法同时最大化分布式认知负担和统一一致性；4. 过渡一致性层（TCL）可以解决这一结构性约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将时间架构形式化为治理理论中的变量；2. 为制度合法性与系统一致性之间的分歧提供统一解释；3. 建立了结构性权衡原则；4. 提出了过渡一致性层的概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为立法改革提供新视角：碎片化是分布式时间压缩的结构性后果；2. 澄清战争授权中分布式道德负担与集中战略一致性之间的张力；3. 应用于政府、企业、国际系统的制度设计；4. 为人工智能等新兴领域提供决策模型协调框架。

title: The First Theorem of Organizational Instability A Proof of the Impossibility of Management under Structural Non-Equilibrium

detail.title: The First Theorem of Organizational Instability A Proof of the Impossibility of Management under Structural Non-Equilibrium

detail.abstract:
For a long time, management studies—across different theoretical traditions and practical approaches—have shared an implicit assumption: that organizations can be managed in a long-term stable manner, and that management failure is primarily the result of insufficient capability, executional deviation, or flawed institutional design. However, this assumption itself has rarely been subjected to systematic scrutiny at the level of existence.

 This paper proposes and defends a negative structural conclusion—the First Theorem of Organizational Instability. By analyzing the irreducible structural conditions of modern organizations—including multi-level decision hierarchies, information asymmetry and temporal delay, asynchronous incentive structures, and the persistent non-stationarity of the external environment—this paper demonstrates that, when these conditions jointly hold, a management equilibrium that can be maintained over the medium to long term without continuous structural repair does not exist.

 This conclusion is neither an empirical generalization nor a probabilistic claim. Rather, it constitutes a structural non-existence result. It does not deny the local effectiveness of management interventions or the possibility of temporary stability. Instead, it rejects the theoretical objective of understanding management as a pathway toward a long-term, stable state of control. Consequently, managerial instability should no longer be interpreted as a practical deviation or managerial failure, but rather as the necessary temporal unfolding of the structural conditions inherent in modern organizations.

 The contribution of this paper lies in elevating the core question of management studies from “how management can be improved” to “whether the goal of management itself exists in structural terms.” In doing so, it marks a structural shift in management theory—from a stability-oriented paradigm to a non-equilibrium understanding—and provides a necessary theoretical foundation for subsequent research on organizational persistence, non-equilibrium governance, and the endurance of uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并论证了"组织不稳定性第一定理"，指出在现代组织的结构性条件下，不存在能够中长期维持而无需持续结构修复的管理均衡。这标志着管理理论从稳定性范式向非均衡理解的转变。
AI.research_question: 在结构性层面上，现代组织是否存在能够中长期维持而无需持续结构修复的管理均衡？
AI.motivation: 传统管理研究隐含假设组织可以长期稳定管理，管理失败主要归因于能力不足、执行偏差或制度设计缺陷。这一假设本身很少在存在层面受到系统性质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织不稳定性第一定理，基于现代组织的不可约结构性条件：多层次决策层级、信息不对称与时间延迟、异步激励结构、外部环境的持续非平稳性。
AI.method: 理论论证与结构分析，通过分析现代组织的基本结构性条件，推导出结构性的非存在性结论。
AI.findings: 当现代组织的结构性条件共同存在时，不存在能够中长期维持而无需持续结构修复的管理均衡。这不是经验概括或概率性主张，而是结构性的非存在性结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将管理研究的核心问题从"如何改进管理"提升到"管理目标本身在结构上是否存在"；2. 标志着管理理论从稳定性范式向非均衡理解的转变；3. 为后续关于组织持续性、非均衡治理和不确定性持久性的研究提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 管理不稳定性不应再被解释为实践偏差或管理失败，而应被视为现代组织内在结构性条件的必然时间展开；2. 重新理解管理干预的局部有效性和暂时稳定性；3. 为组织设计和治理提供新的理论视角。

detail.abstract:
Purpose of the study: This research assessed the moderating role of public sector culture on the relationship between integration capability and service delivery in selected County Governments in North Eastern region of Kenya.

Methodology: The study employed both descriptive and explanatory research designs, guided by a pragmatic philosophical orientation to accommodate multiple perspectives and methods. The target population comprised 263 senior officers from Wajir, Mandera and Garissa Counties in Kenya. Owing to the accessibility of both the population and the geographic region, a census method was adopted to include all eligible respondents. Data collection was conducted using a semi-structured questionnaire, administered through the drop-and-pick method to ensure efficiency and timeliness. Quantitative data were analyzed using frequency distribution tables for clear presentation of results. Qualitative data were subjected to thematic analysis and presented in a narrative format to capture key insights. To test the hypotheses, empirical models were estimated and Analysis of Variance was employed as the primary statistical technique.

Findings: The study findings indicated that the public sector culture was a significant explanatory variable in the relationship between integration capability and service delivery in the selected County Governments in North Eastern region of Kenya.

Conclusion: The study concluded that County Governments should cultivate a robust public sector culture that prioritizes the development of integration capability in encouraging creativity and innovation.

Recommendations: The study recommends that County Governments should cultivate a robust public sector culture that prioritizes the development of integration capability in encouraging creativity and innovation. This research would assist County Governments in formalizing the mechanisms used to incorporate the outcomes of integration capability activities into management programs. It would also help policymakers develop future plans for enhancing effectiveness through the application of integration capability

title: Management Without Equilibrium Management Under Non-Equilibrium Conditions: A Persistence-Oriented Theory of Management

detail.abstract:
Once the structural unavailability of long-term management equilibrium is acknowledged, management theory faces an unavoidable reorientation: if stability and optimal control cannot be achieved in principle, how should the purpose of management be coherently redefined?

 This paper develops a management framework that takes persistent non-equilibrium as its normal condition rather than as an anomaly. Under the constraint of the First Theorem of Organizational Instability, it argues that the core objective of management should no longer be defined as achieving or maintaining stability or optimality, but as sustaining organizational persistence under ongoing instability and uncertainty.

 By systematically distinguishing stability, success, and persistence—three concepts frequently conflated in management theory—the paper identifies persistence as the only management objective that remains structurally consistent under non-equilibrium conditions. On this basis, it formulates four foundational principles of management without equilibrium: abandoning long-term optimality as a governing objective, institutionalizing tolerance for fluctuation and failure, prioritizing structural redundancy over extreme efficiency, and replacing static planning with dynamic governance.

 The paper further examines the implications of this framework for corporate governance, strategy, performance evaluation, management education, and management research. It argues that under non-equilibrium conditions, strategy should be understood not as a blueprint for future states but as a directional constraint on present action; performance indicators should function as state signals rather than control variables; and managers should be reinterpreted as structural regulators rather than system designers.

 Rather than offering improved managerial techniques, this paper advances a normative redefinition of management itself. Its contribution lies in shifting management theory from a stability- and optimization-centered paradigm to one grounded in instability, tolerability, and organizational persistence, thereby establishing the minimum conditions under which management remains conceptually coherent in a non-equilibrium world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的管理框架，将持续非均衡视为常态而非异常。在组织不稳定性第一定理的约束下，管理的核心目标应重新定义为在持续不稳定和不确定性中维持组织存续，而非追求稳定或最优。
AI.research_question: 在承认长期管理均衡结构上不可得的前提下，如何重新定义管理的目的是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统管理理论假设稳定和最优控制是可实现的，但现实中组织面临持续的不稳定性和不确定性。一旦承认长期管理均衡在结构上不可得，管理理论就需要重新定位。

title: Moral Autonomy and Harm Symmetry Theory

detail.title: Moral Autonomy and Harm Symmetry Theory
detail.abstract: The language and structure of this framework have been refined for clarity and academic precision. Crucially, this system introduces a formal resolution to The Demandingness Objection in moral philosophy by establishing a clear distinction between the active generation of unnecessary suffering and the infinite (and often paralyzing) obligation to maximize the good. Core Claim Morality is fundamentally grounded in harm reduction across all conscious beings, including oneself. While autonomy grants an individual the right to choose for themselves, it does not grant moral immunity. Choices are consistently evaluated based on whether they add to or reduce the net suffering in the world. Crucial Distinctions:-You are not morally obligated to maximize your own happiness at all times.-You are not morally obligated to help others at all times.-You are morally prohibited from generating unnecessary suffering-whether directed toward others or toward yourself.

title: Decoding the Neural-Financial Link: A Dynamic Resource Allocation Model Across the Product Life Cycle

detail.title: Decoding the Neural-Financial Link: A Dynamic Resource Allocation Model Across the Product Life Cycle
detail.abstract: The traditional marketing–finance value chain faces mounting validity challenges: its foundational data are compromised by survey integrity problems, its dominant models assume linear relationships that miss threshold effects inherent in human psychology, and its temporal structure ignores product life cycle (PLC) dynamics that alter how marketing inputs translate into financial outputs. This article is a conceptual model paper that develops the DPR-PLC (Dynamic Physiological Response–Product Life Cycle) framework. Rather than testing hypotheses with empirical data, we integrate neurophysiological and behavioral response metrics, PLC-contingent dynamics, and causal machine-learning–based attribution to propose a new framework for understanding how marketing investments create financial value and reduce risk. We develop four formal propositions: (P1) neural arousal exhibits power-law returns in introduction stages; (P2) cognitive ease functions as a financial risk-hedging mechanism in maturity stages; (P3) ignoring PLC-contingent neural dynamics produces systematic measurement bias in uplift estimation; and (P4) PLC-aligned, uplift-based resource allocation dominates static allocation on both return and risk dimensions. We articulate a research agenda with falsification criteria and a managerial decision dashboard featuring a Neural Sensitivity Gap indicator. The framework reframes marketing as a precision instrument for financial risk management and firm value creation across the product life cycle.

title: Calling It What It Is: Climate Change as a Key, Primary, and Direct Push Factor of Migration in the Middle East and North Africa

detail.title: Calling It What It Is: Climate Change as a Key, Primary, and Direct Push Factor of Migration in the Middle East and North Africa

contentType.other: I will be breaking this up into articles to publish in journals, but I also wanted this to exist under my name with the ability to be cited and my argument out there.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that climate change is a key, direct, and primary push factor of migration in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA); a claim that runs counter to the current consensus among scholars, world institutions, and governments, who classify climate change as an indirect or secondary push factor while citing economic and socio-political instability as the primary drivers. This paper challenges that classification by establishing economic and socio-political instability not as independent push factors, but as symptoms of climate change itself. Through analysis of the environmental, economic, and socio-political consequences of climate change in the region, this paper demonstrates that these factors, all rooted in climate change, are culminating in forced migration across MENA. What is currently perceived as economic and socio-political migration is, in actuality, a manifestation of climate change as the underlying root cause, making climate change the genuine key, direct, and primary push factor of migration in the Middle East and North Africa.

detail.abstract: The global food and beverage industry converged upon the Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai Expo City from January 26 to 30, 2026, for the 31st edition of Gulfood, an event that has historically served as a barometer for regional trade dynamics. For Pakistan, Gulfood 2026 represented a milestone of unprecedented scale, characterized by the country's largest-ever official delegation and a record-breaking 142 participating companies. title: SYN-DIGITS: A Synthetic Control Framework for Calibrated Digital Twin Simulation
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School, , Columbia University - Columbia Business School,  and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Decision Risk and Operations

detail.title: SYN-DIGITS: A Synthetic Control Framework for Calibrated Digital Twin Simulation

publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: AI-based persona simulation---often referred to as digital twin simulation---is increasingly used for market research, recommender systems, and social sciences. Despite their flexibility, large language models (LLMs) often exhibit systematic bias and miscalibration relative to real human behavior, limiting their reliability. Inspired by synthetic control methods from causal inference, we propose SYN-DIGITS (SYNthetic Control Framework for Calibrated DIGItal Twin Simulation), a principled and lightweight calibration framework that learns latent structure from digital-twin responses and transfers it to align predictions with human ground truth. SYN-DIGITS operates as a post-processing layer on top of any LLM-based simulator and thus is model-agnostic. We develop a latent factor model that formalizes when and why calibration succeeds through latent space alignment conditions, and we systematically evaluate ten calibration methods across thirteen persona constructions, three LLMs, and two datasets. SYN-DIGITS supports both individual-level and distributional simulation for previously unseen questions and unobserved populations, with provable error guarantees. Experiments show that SYN-DIGITS achieves up to 50% relative improvements in individual-level correlation and 50-90% relative reductions in distributional discrepancy compared to uncalibrated baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SYN-DIGITS框架，通过因果推断中的合成控制方法校准基于大语言模型的数字孪生模拟，减少系统偏差，提高对真实人类行为的预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何校准基于大语言模型的数字孪生模拟，使其预测更准确地反映真实人类行为？
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在数字孪生模拟中具有灵活性，但存在系统偏差和校准不足的问题，限制了其在市场研究、推荐系统和社会科学中的可靠性。

AI.method: SYN-DIGITS框架作为后处理层应用于任何LLM模拟器，通过从数字孪生响应中学习潜在结构，并将其转移到人类真实数据上实现校准。
AI.findings: SYN-DIGITS在个体层面相关性上实现高达50%的相对提升，在分布差异上实现50-90%的相对减少，支持对未见问题和未观测人群的个体和分布模拟。

detail.abstract: Increasing demand for electronic data processing in information technology (IT) and digitalisation of business has led to a growth of energy requited to run data centres. Part of the electrical energy in these centres is used for cooling purposes. This requires adoption of energy efficiency and conservation measures to manage the strain on energy systems and lower both environmental and financial cost of data processing. Free cooling has been suggested as one of the methods of lowering this cost. Studies have not covered areas in tropical regions, and most have omitted the use of relative humidity. This paper presents results of a study carried to evaluate the potential, possibility and viability of cooling in a data centre in Nairobi. This study introduced the concept of using a combination of relative humidity and temperature to determine enthalpy, in the computation of the free cooling potential. Power demand measurements were carried out at the data centre for 10 days. Five-year weather data, that is temperature and humidity, from satellite measurements was recorded and used for determining the free cooling potential. These results show that the data centre cooling system is operating at energy efficiency ratio (EER) of 1.08, out of the rated 3.05. The poor performance can be attributed to the design of the data centre where servers are being cooled from the sides instead of being cooled from the back and cooling operations challenges. Analysis of the four years’ weather data in the location indicate that free cooling can be deployed in the data centre 48.5% to 56.20% of the time annually. This would lead to 35.12% savings of the total annual cooling energy requirements. The potential savings are about half the ones that have been estimated to be achieved in the polar regions.

detail.abstract: This study analyzes the impacts of exchange rate and inflation on exports in Türkiye. Annual data for the period 1995-2023 were used in the analysis. The Johansen cointegration analysis and Dynamic Least Squares (DOLS) method were employed in the study. Identifying the cointegration relationship enabled the estimation of the long-run coefficients. The results show that an increase in the real effective exchange rate (appreciation of the Turkish lira) and inflation reduce exports with coefficients of-0.185 and-0.125, respectively. Foreign direct investment and imports, added to the study as control variables, have a positive impact on exports with coefficients of 0.117 and 0.849, respectively. These findings indicate that exchange rate stability and inflation control are priorities for improving foreign trade performance. Furthermore, policies that increase foreign direct investment and strategically manage imports complement this process.

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the “economy of digital appearance,” in which technological branding discourse precedes actual understanding. It argues that the overuse of “trending tech” terminology distorts technical judgment, inflates perceived value, and shifts focus from structural integrity to superficial innovation. As a result, organizations neglect cybersecurity fundamentals, increasing systemic exposure. The study highlights how this dissociation leads to miscalibrated decisions, inefficient resource allocation, and heightened vulnerability in complex digital environments.

title: The Epistemological Conflict: Analyzing Claims of Extraterrestrial Influence in Ancient India

detail.title: The Epistemological Conflict: Analyzing Claims of Extraterrestrial Influence in Ancient India
detail.abstract: The intellectual history of the Indian subcontinent is characterized by a remarkable continuity of philosophical inquiry, scientific observation, and architectural innovation spanning over five millennia. In recent decades, however, this rich legacy has become a focal point for a set of globalized pseudohistorical narratives collectively referred to as the "ancient alien" theory. These hypotheses posit that the sophisticated achievements of ancient Indian civilization-ranging from the descriptions of aerial vehicles in Sanskrit epics to the precision of Harappan urban planning-can only be explained by the intervention of advanced extraterrestrial beings. While these narratives have gained significant traction in popular media, particularly through sensationalist documentaries and internet forums, they often rely on the systematic misinterpretation of mytho-poetic literature and the selective use of archaeological data. By separating verifiable evidence from speculative extrapolation, a clearer picture emerges: one that reveals the capacity of human ingenuity to innovate within specific environmental, social, and technological contexts without the need for non-human agency. The debate surrounding these claims is not merely a clash between "fringe" and "mainstream" history; it is an epistemological conflict regarding how humanity interprets its past. Proponents of the ancient alien hypothesis frequently employ a cognitive bias known as presentism, wherein modern technological concepts are retroactively projected onto ancient metaphors. This methodology often ignores the cultural and religious frameworks in which ancient texts and monuments were created. For instance, the reinterpretation of the vimāna from a divine, symbolic chariot into a physical spacecraft requires a divorce from the Sanskrit philological tradition and the stratigraphic reality of South Asian archaeology. To understand the reality of ancient India, one must examine the specific claims of aerospace technology, prehistoric nuclear warfare, and "impossible" engineering through the rigorous standards of aeronautical science, materials chemistry, and stratigraphic archaeology.

title: Social Hamiltonian and Legal Engineering: A Constructive Approach to the Latent Torus Concept via Quantum Algorithms and Smart Contracts

detail.title: Social Hamiltonian and Legal Engineering: A Constructive Approach to the Latent Torus Concept via Quantum Algorithms and Smart Contracts

detail.abstract: This study quantifies Large Language Models (LLMs) and humanoids as a new labor force and describes the transformation of economic structures brought about by "super-fluid task allocation involving humans," facilitated by tokenized task transactions built on blockchain technology, from the perspective of statistical physics. Furthermore, we devise a constructive approach called "Legal Engineering" and discuss its governance mechanisms. First, we define the price fluctuations of tokenized tasks as "work volatility" and suggest that, within the scope where specific assumptions (existence of information friction, amplification of interactions, and introduction of approximate effective temperature) hold, phase-transition-like behaviors (rapid changes in order similar to bubbles) can occur in the market. Volatility here is interpreted not merely as a statistic but as an operational approximation of "social temperature" that emerges as a result of amplified information friction and interactions. As a governance mechanism to suppress this entropy increase, we propose the "Latent Torus," an information event horizon. The Latent Torus handles internal optimization invisible from the frontend and ensures sustainable social order by recirculating only optimized parameters to smart contracts. Here, by combining quantum optimization with "Semantic Intervention" via "Regulated LLMs," we aim for stabilization based on "semantic depth" rather than apparent liquidity. Furthermore, we propose a "Grand Unified Algorithm" to simultaneously handle economic efficiency (Hamiltonian minimization), humanity (Well-being), and social credit (Proof of Trust) within a single mathematical framework. The scope of this paper is not to advocate for immediate control of society as a whole, but rather to provide a conceptual model for optimizing and auditing trade-offs between indicators in a consistent manner under limited task spaces, participant sets, and operational rules. As a concrete model, we present "Computational Social Contract Theory (CSCT)" and confirm its behavior and limitations under various assumptions through quantitative analysis using multi-agent simulations. Notably, this theory presents a design policy for realizing "verifiable concealment" in governance under certain assumptions (circuitability, computational assumptions, and soundness of key management/operation) using cryptographic techniques such as zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs). This explores the possibility of hiding the details of internal optimization while maintaining compliance with the Constitutional Core, allowing citizens to verify legitimacy, and examining the operational requirements necessary for such a system. This paper presents a conceptual proposal for institutional design in a post-capitalist society and examines the redesignability of money and law. Note that the quantitative results of this paper are positioned as exploratory simulations and do not directly claim predictive confirmation.

title: When Customer Firms Get Breached: The Appointment of Chief Information Security Officers in Supplier Firms

detail.title: When Customer Firms Get Breached: The Appointment of Chief Information Security Officers in Supplier Firms
detail.abstract: In today's digitally interconnected supply chains, cybersecurity incidents often transcend firm boundaries. Drawing on contingency theory and regulatory focus theory, this study investigates how downstream customer data breaches (CDBs) reshape top management team (TMT) structures in non-breached upstream supplier firms. Using a panel of U.S. publicly listed firms comprising 10,522 firm-year observations from 2005 to 2018, we find that suppliers are more likely to introduce a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) position to their TMTs following CDBs-an adaptive response aligning organizational structures with heightened interfirm cyber risks. This effect is stronger when suppliers are led by prevention-focused Chief Executive Officers (CEOs) and weaker under promotionfocused CEOs, highlighting the role of executive cognition in structural adaptation. Leveraging the staggered adoption of U.S. state-level data breach notification laws as a quasinatural experiment, we further show that CDBs more strongly prompt CISO introductions after these laws take effect. Robustness checks using propensity-score matching, alternative operationalizations, and subsample analyses support our findings. This study advances information systems and cybersecurity governance research by revealing how interorganizational breaches trigger adaptive structural change and by identifying CEO regulatory focus as a key boundary condition.

AI.tldr: 下游客户数据泄露促使上游供应商公司在高管团队中增设首席信息安全官职位，这一效应在预防导向的CEO领导下更强，在促进导向的CEO领导下更弱，且数据泄露通知法律强化了这种效应。

AI.theoretical_framework: 权变理论（contingency theory）和调节焦点理论（regulatory focus theory）。权变理论解释组织如何适应环境变化，调节焦点理论解释CEO认知如何影响组织响应。
AI.method: 使用2005-2018年美国上市公司面板数据（10,522个公司年度观测值）。采用准自然实验设计，利用美国州级数据泄露通知法律的交错实施作为外生冲击。进行倾向得分匹配、替代操作化、子样本分析等稳健性检验。

detail.title: The Klyrox Protocol -A Decentralized Framework for Optimistic Content Verification and Epistemic Reputation
detail.abstract:
The contemporary digital information ecosystem is suffering from a structural market failure analogous to George Akerlof’s "Market for Lemons." In an era of Generative AI, the marginal cost of producing misinformation has approached zero, while the cost of verifying truth remains high. This asymmetry has created a "Trust Deficit" where high-quality information cannot be reliably distinguished from algorithmic noise. Current remediation strategies are bifurcated between two flawed extremes: Centralized Web2 Platforms (which prioritize scalability at the expense of transparency and are prone to censorship) and Decentralized Web3 Networks (which prioritize immutability but suffer from the "Garbage In, Garbage Out" paradox - permanently recording unverified data).

The Trust-Scalability Trilemma: This research posits that decentralized reputation systems face a "Trust-Scalability Trilemma," historically unable to simultaneously achieve Veracity (Accuracy), Scalability (Throughput), and Decentralization (Censorship Resistance). Traditional solutions, such as Token Curated Registries (TCRs), have failed because they rely on synchronous, on-chain voting for every data point, resulting in prohibitive latency and gas costs.

The Solution: This paper introduces The Klyrox Protocol, a decentralized middleware designed to resolve this trilemma by decoupling Content Execution from Content Verification. The protocol introduces a novel consensus mechanism, "Proof-of-Klyrox," which combines Optimistic Machine Learning (opML) with Game Theoretic Integrity Bonds. Proof-of-Klyrox is not a blockchain consensus mechanism. It is a layered fraud-detection and incentive framework anchored to existing consensus networks.

Scope Note: Protocol V1 focuses exclusively on objective, verifiable claims (e.g., market data, timestamped events, quantifiable metrics). Subjective content quality assessment (e.g., editorial judgment, artistic merit) is explicitly out of scope and scheduled for research in future iterations.

The system operates on an "Optimistic" presumption of validity:

  • Optimistic Execution: Content is verified instantly via off-chain AI Oracles, reducing verification costs by an estimated 85-95% compared to traditional on-chain governance models.
  • Cryptoeconomic Security: Users must stake financial collateral (Integrity Bonds) to publish. This creates a "Pay-to-Truth" incentive structure where the cost of generating misinformation strictly exceeds the potential profit.
  • Sybil Resistance: The protocol implements a proprietary Time-Decayed Stake-Weighted (TDSW) algorithm. This scoring engine ensures that influence scales logarithmically with capital (preventing plutocratic capture) and decays exponentially over time (preventing the entrenchment of dormant actors).

By financializing reputation into a portable, quantifiable asset class defined as "Epistemic Capital," The Klyrox Protocol offers a scalable blueprint for a self-regulating "Market for Truth." It transforms trust from a subjective social sentiment into an objective, verifiable economic product, providing the necessary infrastructure for the next generation of decentralized media, prediction markets, and AI safety layers.

Author's Note: This whitepaper outlines the technical architecture and game-theoretic mechanisms underpinning the concept of "Epistemic Capital," as explored in The Algorithmic Monographs series by Ali Sadhik Shaik (The Algorithmic Invisible Hand, The Republic of Code, The Market for Truth, The Heavy Metal Intelligence and The Synthetic C-Cuite).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Klyrox协议，通过将内容执行与内容验证解耦，结合乐观机器学习与博弈论诚信债券，解决去中心化声誉系统中的"信任-可扩展性三元悖论"，为数字信息生态系统创建可自我调节的"真理市场"。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个去中心化协议，能够同时实现准确性、可扩展性和抗审查性，解决数字信息生态系统中的信任赤字问题？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI时代，虚假信息的生产边际成本趋近于零，而验证真相的成本仍然很高，导致"信任赤字"。当前解决方案存在两极分化：中心化Web2平台牺牲透明度换取可扩展性，去中心化Web3网络存在"垃圾进垃圾出"悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 阿克洛夫"柠檬市场"理论；2. 信任-可扩展性三元悖论；3. 博弈论与激励机制设计；4. 乐观机器学习理论；5. 加密经济学安全模型。
AI.method: 提出Klyrox协议，采用"Proof-of-Klyrox"共识机制，结合乐观机器学习与博弈论诚信债券。系统基于乐观有效性假设运行，包括乐观执行、加密经济安全和女巫抵抗机制。
AI.findings: 协议通过将内容执行与验证解耦，估计可降低85-95%的验证成本。通过诚信债券创建"付费求真"激励结构，使虚假信息生成成本严格超过潜在收益。时间衰减股权加权算法防止财阀控制和休眠参与者固化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"信任-可扩展性三元悖论"理论框架；2. 引入"认知资本"概念，将声誉金融化为可量化资产类别；3. 开发Proof-of-Klyrox共识机制，结合乐观机器学习与博弈论设计；4. 提出时间衰减股权加权算法解决女巫攻击问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为去中心化媒体、预测市场和AI安全层提供基础设施；2. 创建可自我调节的"真理市场"；3. 将信任从主观社会情感转化为客观可验证的经济产品；4. 为下一代信息生态系统提供可扩展蓝图。

title: What is Generative AI Worth?
affiliations: , National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), , Carnegie Mellon University and Copenhagen Business School - Department of Marketing

detail.title: What is Generative AI Worth?
detail.abstract: We estimate the consumer welfare gains from the rapid adoption of generative AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Copilot in the United States. Using online choice experiments, we elicit willingness to accept (WTA) compensation for giving up access to these AI chatbot tools for one month from representative samples of US adults, fielded in two waves, July 2025 and March 2026. We find that mean willingness to accept (WTA) increased from $98 in 2025 to $124.50 in 2026, a 27% increase, while the median value rose from $3.4 to $11.40. Combined with growth in the adult user base from 98 million to 115 million, these estimates imply that aggregate consumer surplus increased from $116 billion to $172 billion. This surplus substantially exceeds estimated revenues from generative AI in the United States, suggesting that consumers capture most of the welfare gains from these tools. We find substantial heterogeneity in valuations: usage frequency is the strongest predictor of WTA, followed by workplace use, and paid subscription status, with additional differences by gender, age, and ethnicity. Overall, the results suggest that generative AI is already generating substantial and rapidly growing welfare gains, even before its full effects on measured productivity and GDP are reflected in official statistics.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在线选择实验测量美国消费者对生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT、Gemini等）的支付意愿，发现2025-2026年间平均WTA从98美元增至124.5美元，用户基数从9800万增至1.15亿，总消费者剩余从1160亿美元增至1720亿美元，远超行业收入，表明消费者获得了大部分福利收益。
AI.research_question: 美国消费者从生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Copilot）的快速采用中获得了多少消费者福利增益？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具正在被快速采用，但消费者从这些工具中获得的实际福利增益尚未得到量化测量。了解这些福利增益的规模、增长和分布对于评估AI技术的经济影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者福利经济学、支付意愿（WTA）理论、消费者剩余理论、技术采纳与扩散理论。
AI.method: 使用在线选择实验，从美国成年人的代表性样本中收集数据，分别在2025年7月和2026年3月进行两波调查，通过补偿意愿（WTA）方法测量消费者对放弃使用AI聊天工具一个月的价值评估。
AI.findings: 1. 平均WTA从2025年的98美元增加到2026年的124.5美元（增长27%），中位数从3.4美元增加到11.4美元；2. 成年用户基数从9800万增加到1.15亿；3. 总消费者剩余从1160亿美元增加到1720亿美元；4. 消费者剩余远超美国生成式AI的估计收入，表明消费者获得了大部分福利；5. 估值存在显著异质性：使用频率是最强预测因子，其次是工作场所使用和付费订阅状态，性别、年龄和种族也存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次量化测量了生成式AI工具的消费者福利增益；2. 提供了消费者剩余超过行业收入的实证证据，支持消费者获得技术福利的观点；3. 揭示了AI工具价值评估的异质性模式；4. 展示了技术采纳早期阶段的福利动态变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了AI技术经济影响的量化基准；2. 帮助企业了解消费者对AI工具的真实价值感知；3. 为AI产品定价和市场策略提供数据支持；4. 有助于评估AI技术对消费者福利的分配效应。

title: Beyond Project Cybersyn: Tracing the Influence of Stafford Beer Projects and Ideas in Latin America

detail.title: Beyond Project Cybersyn: Tracing the Influence of Stafford Beer Projects and Ideas in Latin America

declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

keywords: Democracy Clinical Trial Number Not applicable

publicationDetails.detailsText: Systemic Practice and Action Research, volume 38, issue 2, 2025[10.1007/s11213-025-09717-2]

detail.abstract: This paper explores Stafford Beer's lesser-known journeys and collaborations in Latin America beyond the well-known Chilean project Cybersyn. It traces Beer's involvement in the region back to the 1960s through his company SIGMA and its projects in Chile, as well as its attempts to expand into other Latin American countries. The paper also sheds light on a relatively unknown project in the 1970s in Peru, the Centre for the Study of People's Participation (CENTRO), which was influenced by Beer's ideas on real-time enterprise information and control systems. Furthermore, it explores Beer's involvement in various projects across Latin America during the 1980s and 1990s, as the region gradually returned to democracy, including cases in Mexico, Uruguay (URUCIB), Venezuela (Cybervenez), and Colombia. While some implementations, particularly in Uruguay and Colombia, demonstrated the Viable System Model's (VSM) potential for fostering genuine organizational democracy and social transformation, others in Mexico and Venezuela failed due to political instability or systemic corruption. The paper argues that though Beer's VSM is often characterized as purely technocratic, its implementation in Latin America reveals that while sometimes appropriated by neoliberal reforms, it also aligned with regional aspirations for social transformation and creative liberation through the use of technology, challenging persistent biases about where technological innovation can originate.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Stafford Beer在拉丁美洲鲜为人知的旅程与合作，超越了著名的智利Cybersyn项目。研究发现Beer从1960年代就开始通过SIGMA公司在拉美活动，包括秘鲁的CENTRO项目，以及1980-90年代在墨西哥、乌拉圭、委内瑞拉和哥伦比亚的项目。研究表明VSM模型在拉美既被新自由主义改革利用，也与地区社会转型和技术解放的愿望相契合。
AI.research_question: Stafford Beer在拉丁美洲（除智利Cybersyn项目外）的旅程、合作和项目有哪些？这些项目如何体现VSM模型在拉美地区的应用和影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注Beer在智利的Cybersyn项目，但对其在拉美其他地区的活动和影响了解有限。本文旨在填补这一空白，揭示Beer在拉美更广泛的影响，挑战技术创新起源的固有偏见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于Stafford Beer的Viable System Model（VSM，可行系统模型），探讨该模型在组织民主、社会转型和技术创新方面的理论框架。
AI.method: 历史追溯和案例研究方法，通过档案研究、历史文献分析和多个案例比较，重建Beer在拉美地区的活动轨迹和项目影响。
AI.findings: 1. Beer从1960年代就开始通过SIGMA公司在拉美活动；2. 发现了秘鲁CENTRO项目等鲜为人知的案例；3. 1980-90年代在墨西哥、乌拉圭、委内瑞拉和哥伦比亚都有项目；4. 乌拉圭和哥伦比亚项目展示了VSM促进组织民主的潜力；5. 墨西哥和委内瑞拉项目因政治不稳定或腐败而失败；6. VSM在拉美既被新自由主义利用，也与地区社会转型愿望相契合。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了VSM作为纯粹技术官僚工具的刻板印象；2. 展示了VSM在促进组织民主和社会转型方面的潜力；3. 揭示了技术创新可以来自全球南方，挑战了技术创新起源的地理偏见。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为拉美地区组织变革提供了历史经验；2. 展示了VSM在不同政治经济环境下的应用可能性；3. 为当前技术与社会转型的讨论提供了历史参照；4. 为理解技术、民主和社会变革的关系提供了实践案例。

title: (How) Can LLMs Enhance Privacy Research?
affiliations: and University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: (How) Can LLMs Enhance Privacy Research?
detail.abstract: Understanding consumer privacy preferences and decision-making is crucial for businesses and policymakers, yet large-scale surveys and experiments remain costly. As large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate privacy-sensitive interactions, understanding their privacy-related behavioral patterns is critical for both research methodology and anticipating AI-mediated privacy outcomes. We investigate whether LLMs can serve as a usable research infrastructure for privacy research through three stages: (1) establishing whether LLMs exhibit behavioral patterns consistent with a privacy mindset, (2) calibrating them to align with human responses, and (3) deploying them to delineate the boundaries of their utility. In the Foundation stage, we benchmark LLM responses against human subjects and find that LLMs exhibit higher concern levels than humans on privacy preferences while adopting more relaxed stances in real-world decision-making scenarios. In the Calibration stage, we propose a methodology integrating multi-persona modeling, Generative Adversarial Networks, and interpretable machine learning to reduce the systematic gap between LLM and human responses. Our approach generates calibrated synthetic personas grounded in empirically identified privacy-relevant attributes. In the Deployment stage, we examine whether calibrated synthetic participants can reproduce established privacy findings. By systematically replicating published privacy experiments, we find that a substantial share of findings is reproduced. The pattern of successes and failures reveals a spectrum of privacy cognition: LLMs reliably replicate findings grounded in analytical, semantic reasoning but fail where mechanisms involve non-analytical processing such as heuristic framing or experiential-economic mechanisms. Our study provides a scalable tool for generating synthetic human privacy responses with clear boundary conditions for reliable application.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）能否作为隐私研究的可用基础设施，通过三个阶段验证：发现LLMs比人类更关注隐私偏好但在实际决策中更宽松；开发校准方法减少LLM与人类响应差距；验证校准后合成参与者能否复现已知隐私研究发现。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型能否作为隐私研究的可用研究基础设施？
AI.motivation: 传统大规模隐私调查和实验成本高昂，而LLMs越来越多地参与隐私敏感交互，理解其隐私相关行为模式对研究方法和预测AI中介的隐私结果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐私决策理论、隐私心态行为模式、多角色建模、生成对抗网络、可解释机器学习、隐私认知谱系（分析性语义推理 vs. 非分析性处理如启发式框架或经验经济机制）
AI.method: 三阶段方法：1）基础阶段：将LLM响应与人类受试者基准比较；2）校准阶段：整合多角色建模、生成对抗网络和可解释机器学习减少系统差距；3）部署阶段：通过系统复制已发表隐私实验验证校准合成参与者能否复现研究发现。
AI.findings: 1）LLMs在隐私偏好上表现出比人类更高的关注水平，但在实际决策场景中采取更宽松立场；2）校准方法能生成基于经验识别隐私相关属性的合成角色；3）相当大比例的研究发现能被复现，但LLMs能可靠复现基于分析性语义推理的发现，而在涉及启发式框架或经验经济机制等非分析性处理的机制上失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了LLMs作为隐私研究基础设施的理论框架；2）提出了隐私认知谱系理论，区分分析性语义推理和非分析性处理机制；3）发展了多角色建模与生成对抗网络结合的校准方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了生成合成人类隐私响应的可扩展工具；2）明确了可靠应用的边界条件；3）降低了隐私研究的成本，为企业和政策制定者提供了新的研究方法。

title: Private Context Architecture - An Entity-Sovereign Cognition Infrastructure for AI Systems

detail.title: Private Context Architecture - An Entity-Sovereign Cognition Infrastructure for AI Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
The current enterprise AI stack lacks a persistent, entity-owned cognition layer that captures how an individual or organization operates and makes that institutional intelligence available to AI systems at inference time. Existing approaches—retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, agent memory frameworks, and sovereign data platforms—each address fragments of this problem but none provide the architectural synthesis required: a system that learns from interaction, structures what it learns into a sovereign cognition graph, extracts algorithmically bounded minimal context for downstream AI consumption, and enforces privacy and integrity structurally rather than contractually.

This paper introduces the Private Context Architecture (PCA), a new infrastructure tier comprising a Private Context Engine, a Private Cognition Graph, a governed write pipeline, and a zero-knowledge transport layer. The architecture operates on the principle that the intelligence derived from an entity’s operations belongs to that entity—not to the platforms that process it. Privacy guarantees are cryptographic. Context poisoning defense is structural. The system self-improves through adaptive confidence scoring and autonomous self-correction. This paper describes the architectural paradigm, its core components, and the design principles governing their interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出私有上下文架构(PCA)，作为企业AI栈中的持久性认知层，通过私有认知图、受控写入管道和零知识传输层，实现机构智能的自主学习和隐私保护。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个持久、实体拥有的认知层，能够捕获个体或组织的运作方式，并在推理时将这些机构智能提供给AI系统，同时确保隐私和完整性？
AI.motivation: 当前企业AI栈缺乏持久、实体拥有的认知层，现有方法（检索增强生成、知识图谱、代理记忆框架、主权数据平台）各自解决部分问题，但缺乏完整的架构综合，无法实现从交互中学习、结构化学习内容、提取最小上下文、以及结构性而非契约性隐私保护。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权认知理论、隐私保护计算、零知识证明、自适应置信度评分、自主自我修正机制、上下文中毒防御结构设计。
AI.method: 提出私有上下文架构(PCA)作为新的基础设施层，包含私有上下文引擎、私有认知图、受控写入管道和零知识传输层，采用密码学隐私保证和结构性防御设计。
AI.findings: PCA架构能够实现实体智能的自主拥有、密码学隐私保护、结构性上下文中毒防御，并通过自适应置信度评分和自主自我修正实现系统自我改进。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出主权认知层概念框架；2) 建立实体智能所有权理论；3) 发展结构性而非契约性的隐私保护范式；4) 提出自适应置信度评分和自主修正机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业AI栈提供完整的认知层架构；2) 实现机构智能的自主拥有和保护；3) 提供可部署的隐私保护解决方案；4) 支持AI系统的持续学习和改进。

title: Acquiring Firm Inventors' Performance: Exploring the Alignment of Inventors' Knowledge Base with Firms' Innovation Trajectories
affiliations: University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - College of Business, Northeastern University and INSEAD - Strategy

detail.title: Acquiring Firm Inventors' Performance: Exploring the Alignment of Inventors' Knowledge Base with Firms' Innovation Trajectories
detail.abstract: Innovation-sourcing acquisitions provide firms with rapid access to new knowledge, but their success depends on how effectively the acquiring firm integrates this knowledge. Prior research has focused on firm-level absorptive capacity, yet little is known about how such acquisitions affect inventors within acquiring firms who embody much of this capacity. We theorize that acquiring firm inventors' post-acquisition performance will be shaped by the interaction between their own knowledge and the firms' characteristics, namely, a) the technological distance between the acquiring and target firms, and b) the alignment of the inventors' knowledge with the firms' post-acquisition innovation trajectory. We argue that although acquiring firm inventors generally experience a decline in post-acquisition innovation performance, generalists face a smaller decline than specialists in distant acquisitions, and specialists experience a smaller decline than generalists in close acquisitions. Our predictions are conditional on whether the inventors continue to patent after the acquisition: inventors will be more likely to continue patenting when their knowledge base aligns with the firm's postacquisition innovation trajectory. Using panel data on 334 pharmaceutical acquisitions between 1990 and 2007, we find support for our hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了创新获取型收购后，收购方发明家的创新表现如何受到其自身知识基础与公司特征（技术距离、创新轨迹对齐）交互作用的影响。
AI.research_question: 创新获取型收购如何影响收购方发明家的后续创新表现？发明家的知识基础（专家vs通才）与公司特征（技术距离、创新轨迹对齐）如何交互影响这种表现？
AI.motivation: 虽然创新获取型收购为企业提供了快速获取新知识的途径，但成功取决于知识整合效果。现有研究主要关注公司层面的吸收能力，却忽视了收购对体现这种能力的发明家个体的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于吸收能力理论，强调发明家个体知识基础与公司特征的交互作用：技术距离（收购方与目标公司的技术差异）和创新轨迹对齐（发明家知识基础与收购后公司创新方向的一致性）。
AI.method: 使用1990-2007年间334个制药行业收购的面板数据，分析收购后发明家的专利表现。

title: Design, Verify, Deploy: The New Platform-Based Design Paradigm for Large-Scale Energy System Retrofits

detail.title: Design, Verify, Deploy: The New Platform-Based Design Paradigm for Large-Scale Energy System Retrofits
detail.abstract:
Achieving energy security and resilience in large-scale building retrofits requires a scalable process to manage complex system integration. This is critical for entities like the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), which faces the daunting task of retrofitting an estimated two military bases per month to maintain a 25-year upgrade cycle. To address this, we developed and demonstrated Platform-Based Design (PBD) for an energy system retrofit of 17 buildings at Joint Base Andrews. PBD replaces traditional, ad-hoc engineering with a data-driven, sequential workflow using reusable models of increasing fidelity to verify candidate solutions against functional requirements.
Initial multi-objective optimizations using Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) identified a geothermal-coupled Thermal Energy Network (TEN) integrated with photovoltaics and batteries as the ideal configuration. A subsequent de-risking phase that utilized fully coupled, nonlinear dynamic simulations via the Modelica Buildings Library revealed critical design flaws, including an overestimation of the geothermal borefield’s dynamic heat transfer. The model-based identification of these design flaws prevented recommendations of a design that would result in physical installation failures and multi-million dollar change orders.
The finalized, Pareto-optimal TEN design reduces imported energy by 74% and peak electrical demand by 45% relative to a conventional gas heating and air-source chiller cooling baseline. It enhances mission resilience with a levelized cost of energy of $0.210/kWh and only a marginal 6% life-cycle cost increase. Furthermore, the PBD process identified over $2 million in investment costs and $300,000 in annualized life cycle cost savings, paying for the advanced design process itself. Ultimately, by shifting from physical testing to virtual verification, PBD provides the formalized, digitalized paradigm essential for executing reliable, cost-effective energy retrofits at a massive scale.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并演示了基于平台的设计（PBD）方法，用于大型建筑能源系统改造。该方法通过数据驱动的顺序工作流程，使用可重复使用的模型来验证候选方案。在联合基地安德鲁斯的17栋建筑改造中，PBD识别出地热耦合热能源网络与光伏电池集成的最优配置，避免了关键设计缺陷，实现了74%的能源进口减少和45%的峰值电力需求降低。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个可扩展的、基于平台的设计方法，以管理大型建筑能源改造中的复杂系统集成，实现能源安全和韧性？
AI.motivation: 美国国防部等实体面临大规模建筑改造的挑战，需要每月改造两个军事基地以维持25年升级周期。传统临时工程方法无法满足复杂系统集成的需求，需要更系统化的设计流程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平台的设计（PBD）理论框架，取代传统的临时工程方法，采用数据驱动的顺序工作流程，使用可重复使用的模型进行功能需求验证。
AI.method: 1. 使用混合整数线性规划（MILP）进行多目标优化，识别最优配置；2. 使用Modelica建筑库进行完全耦合的非线性动态模拟进行风险降低；3. 在联合基地安德鲁斯的17栋建筑进行案例研究。
AI.findings: 1. 地热耦合热能源网络与光伏电池集成是最优配置；2. 风险降低阶段发现关键设计缺陷（如地热钻孔场动态传热高估）；3. 最终设计减少74%进口能源和45%峰值电力需求；4. 能源平准化成本为0.210美元/千瓦时，生命周期成本仅增加6%；5. PBD过程识别出200万美元投资成本和30万美元年度生命周期成本节省。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了基于平台的设计（PBD）理论框架，用于大规模能源改造；2. 提出了从物理测试转向虚拟验证的数字化范式；3. 建立了可扩展的系统集成管理方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为美国国防部等实体提供了可扩展的改造流程；2. 避免了数百万美元的变更订单和物理安装失败；3. 实现了显著的能源和成本节省；4. 提供了大规模可靠、经济高效能源改造的实践方法。

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1191
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study leverages high-frequency foot-traffic data from SafeGraph to estimate demand shocks in customer-facing establishments across New York City's retail, service, and health sectors. Recognizing that variations in foot traffic can arise from both unpredictable demand shocks and firm-driven strategies to attract customers, we present a theoretical framework that isolates establishment-level demand fluctuations from firm-level strategic choices. Implementing this empirically, we employ an unsupervised machine learning approach to classify establishments into distinct categories that are largely orthogonal to location and sector. We find important heterogeneity in the persistence of shocks, important heterogeneity in their trends, and that estimation on a pooled sample importantly understates the variance experienced by some establishments.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用SafeGraph的高频人流数据估计纽约市零售、服务和医疗行业面向客户场所的需求冲击。通过理论框架区分企业层面的战略选择与场所层面的需求波动，并采用无监督机器学习方法对场所进行分类。研究发现冲击持续性存在显著异质性，趋势存在重要差异，且混合样本估计会低估某些场所经历的方差。
AI.research_question: 如何从高频人流数据中分离出企业战略选择与场所层面的需求冲击？不同类别场所的需求冲击持续性、趋势和方差有何异质性？
AI.motivation: 人流变化可能源于不可预测的需求冲击或企业吸引客户的战略决策，需要区分这两者以准确理解市场动态。现有研究往往忽视这种区分，导致对需求冲击的估计存在偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建立理论框架，将人流变化分解为企业层面的战略选择（如营销、定价策略）和场所层面的需求冲击（如消费者偏好变化、外部冲击）。该框架假设战略选择在短期内相对稳定，而需求冲击更具随机性。
AI.method: 使用SafeGraph的高频人流数据；采用无监督机器学习方法（如聚类分析）对场所进行分类，分类标准与人流模式相关但与地理位置和行业类别正交；通过统计方法估计需求冲击的持续性、趋势和方差。
AI.findings: 1. 不同类别场所的需求冲击持续性存在显著异质性；2. 需求冲击的趋势在不同类别间存在重要差异；3. 混合样本估计会显著低估某些场所经历的方差，表明异质性对准确估计至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了区分企业战略选择与场所需求冲击的理论框架；发展了基于人流数据的异质性需求冲击估计方法；为理解市场动态提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了更准确的需求冲击评估工具；帮助政策制定者更好地理解不同行业和区域的经济韧性；为投资者和商业分析师提供了更精细的市场动态分析框架。

detail.abstract: The proliferation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in civil, commercial, and defence domains has exposed a critical architectural gap: existing platforms optimise either communication or perception independently, leaving safety coverage incomplete under simultaneous stress in Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) operations. This paper proposes the Risk-Aware UAV Safety Architecture (RASA), a three-layer conceptual framework integrating multi-modal sensor fusion, satellite communication (SATCOM), and AI-driven risk modelling aligned with functional safety principles such as ISO 26262. The RASA framework quantifies operational risk as R(t) = α•Usensor(t) + β•Lc(t)-a function of sensor uncertainty and communication latency, enabling onboard risk estimation without ground-in-the-loop dependency. Building on prior validated work in multi-modal sensor fusion for safety-critical human detection and SATCOM communication architectures for UAV connectivity, this paper extends those contributions to the BVLOS domain. This paper addresses the critical gap in BVLOS UAV safety architectures by integrating perception and communication reliability within a single, auditable, risk-aware framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RASA（风险感知无人机安全架构），一个三层概念框架，通过多模态传感器融合、卫星通信和AI驱动风险建模，解决BVLOS操作中感知与通信可靠性整合的架构空白。
AI.research_question: 如何在超越视距（BVLOS）无人机操作中，整合感知和通信可靠性，构建一个统一的风险感知安全架构？
AI.motivation: 现有无人机平台要么优化通信，要么优化感知，但在BVLOS操作中同时面临压力时，安全覆盖不完整，存在关键架构空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ISO 26262等功能安全原则，提出三层概念框架：多模态传感器融合、卫星通信（SATCOM）、AI驱动风险建模。风险量化公式：R(t) = α•Usensor(t) + β•Lc(t)，其中Usensor(t)是传感器不确定性，Lc(t)是通信延迟。
AI.method: 概念框架设计，整合先前已验证的多模态传感器融合（用于安全关键人员检测）和SATCOM通信架构，扩展到BVLOS领域。
AI.findings: RASA框架能够在无需地面回路依赖的情况下进行机载风险估计，量化操作风险为传感器不确定性和通信延迟的函数。

detail.abstract:
We examine the impact of the Green Remodeling Program on the energy consumption of public buildings in South Korea. Using monthly building-level utility data, we find that participation in the Green Remodeling Program reduces energy use on average by roughly 8–15% for electricity and 5–8% for gas, with savings that emerge gradually and persist over the post-retrofit period despite modest rebound effects in some facility types. Effects are heterogeneous: savings are most consistently observed for daycare centers, and the largest, most precisely estimated reductions are concentrated in envelope upgrades and on-site generation, with complete envelope retrofit packages delivering the biggest reductions across both fuels. These results imply that we can improve the cost-effectiveness of public-building decarbonization by prioritizing deep, bundled
envelope retrofits, tailoring guidance and targeting by facility type, and strengthening post-retrofit commissioning and multi-year measurement and verification so that subsidies are tied to realized performance rather than installed measures. More broadly, our results inform the policy debate on whether publicly supported building retrofit programs can effectively reduce energy demand and support climate mitigation.

title: Valuing Complexity in Structural Models

detail.title: Valuing Complexity in Structural Models
detail.abstract: Structural model specification involves a trade-off between flexibility and identification. Researchers often introduce additional complexity to expand the set of counterfactuals a model can address, but doing so imposes a statistical cost on what the data can support. This paper develops a framework for evaluating this trade-off by quantifying the value of complexity in terms of robust counterfactual predictions. Using spectral information geometry, I measure complexity via the entropy of the identification operator and derive a counterfactual feasibility frontier that links model complexity, sample size, and counterfactual validity. The analysis shows that additional flexibility can reduce policy relevance, even when model fit improves.

title: How Much Should a Conversational Recommender System Converse?

detail.title: How Much Should a Conversational Recommender System Converse?
detail.abstract: Conversational recommender systems powered by generative AI can enhance personalization by facilitating information elicitation through follow-up questions. However, engaging in these conversations imposes a communication cost on users. As platforms with different objectives and monetization models deploy these systems, a central question is: how does the platform’s objective and sellers’ strategic response shape the design of these systems in terms of their elicitation strategy? We develop a parsimonious model of conversational elicitation in which interaction generates noisy preference information and imposes a communication cost borne by the user. A user-welfare-maximizing platform elicits more information when accurate niche matching yields large gains, even when niche users are rare. In contrast, under a conversion objective, for the same setting, the optimal strategy is to immediately recommend the same mainstream option to all users with no or minimal preference elicitation because the incremental conversion benefit from improved matching is bounded, while communication costs are borne by all users. When prices are endogenous and the platform earns a commission, increased elicitation is again optimal because improved screening raises equilibrium prices and platform revenue; however, these price responses can counteract consumer benefits and reduce user welfare. The model also highlights that the optimal elicitation intensity increases with preference heterogeneity, helping explain why conversational systems ask more in highly differentiated categories than in low-heterogeneity ones. We complement the theory with a dataset of long-form product queries that vary in length and informational content. Using our dataset and LLM-based user simulation, we quantify how additional information impacts user decisions and demonstrate that the magnitude of this impact depends on the degree of preference heterogeneity. Additionally, this dataset provides a testbed for measuring the (incremental) value of preference elicitation and may be of independent interest.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了对话式推荐系统中平台目标和卖家策略如何影响偏好信息获取策略的设计。研究发现：用户福利最大化的平台会积极获取信息以精准匹配小众需求，而转化率导向的平台则倾向于推荐主流选项以减少用户沟通成本。当价格内生时，平台会通过信息获取提高价格和佣金收入，但这可能损害消费者福利。
AI.research_question: 平台的商业目标和卖家的策略性反应如何塑造对话式推荐系统的信息获取策略设计？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI驱动的对话式推荐系统通过后续问题获取用户偏好信息，但这给用户带来了沟通成本。不同平台有不同的目标和盈利模式，需要理解这些因素如何影响系统设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和博弈论，构建了对话式信息获取的简约模型，考虑偏好信息获取的噪声性和用户承担的沟通成本。
AI.method: 理论建模分析不同平台目标下的最优信息获取策略；实证部分使用包含不同长度和信息内容的产品查询数据集，结合基于LLM的用户模拟，量化额外信息对用户决策的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 用户福利最大化平台会积极获取信息以匹配小众需求；2) 转化率导向平台倾向于推荐主流选项，减少信息获取；3) 价格内生时，平台通过信息获取提高价格和佣金，但可能损害消费者福利；4) 最优信息获取强度随偏好异质性增加而增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了对话式推荐系统中平台目标、卖家策略与信息获取策略的理论框架；2) 揭示了不同商业目标下最优信息获取策略的差异；3) 分析了价格内生性对平台策略和消费者福利的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为平台设计对话式推荐系统提供决策依据；2) 解释了为何不同品类中对话系统提问强度不同；3) 提供了测量偏好信息获取价值的测试数据集和方法。

No proprietary systems, source code, or confidential information are disclosed in this paper.

detail.abstract: Sanctions screening-the process by which financial institutions determine whether counterparties to financial transactions match entities on government watchlists-remains one of the most consequential applications of entity resolution in production computing. Despite two decades of advancements in natural language processing, knowledge graph construction, and neural embedding models, the dominant commercial screening platforms continue to rely on string-based matching architectures that produce false positive rates exceeding 95% and fail systematically on cross-lingual, cross-script, and network-based evasion patterns. This paper proposes a comprehensive, multi-modal architecture for AI-native sanctions screening that fundamentally departs from the legacy paradigm. The proposed system integrates five architectural innovations: (1) a multi-gate scoring pipeline combining trigram index lookup, embedding-based semantic search, phonetic analysis, and fuzzy matching in a parallel candidate discovery framework; (2) high-dimensional vector embeddings for semantic entity resolution that function like GPS coordinates-mapping entities to fixed points in 3072-dimensional space regardless of script, language, or transliteration variant; (3) AI adjudication at the core of the screening process using large language models to resolve ambiguous matches; (4) a Living Knowledge Graph maintained by autonomous AI investigation agents for detecting networkbased sanctions evasion; and (5) an intelligent lifecycle screening framework that goes beyond legacy delta screening by applying the full AI-native pipeline to every re-screening pass, supported by temporal versioning for regulatory audit compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全面的多模态AI原生制裁筛查架构，通过整合五项创新技术来替代传统的基于字符串匹配的系统，显著降低误报率并解决跨语言、跨脚本和网络规避问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个AI原生的制裁筛查系统，以解决传统基于字符串匹配方法的高误报率（超过95%）以及无法有效处理跨语言、跨脚本和网络规避模式的问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管自然语言处理、知识图谱构建和神经嵌入模型已有20年发展，但主流商业筛查平台仍依赖基于字符串匹配的架构，导致误报率超过95%，且无法系统性地处理跨语言、跨脚本和网络规避模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态AI架构、高维向量嵌入理论、语义实体解析、AI裁决机制、自主AI调查代理、知识图谱维护、智能生命周期筛查框架。
AI.method: 提出包含五项架构创新的系统：1) 多门评分管道（三字索引查找、嵌入语义搜索、语音分析、模糊匹配并行候选发现）；2) 3072维高维向量嵌入；3) 基于大语言模型的AI裁决；4) 自主AI调查代理维护的活知识图谱；5) 智能生命周期筛查框架。
AI.findings: 提出的AI原生制裁筛查架构能够从根本上改进传统系统，通过多模态方法显著降低误报率，有效处理跨语言、跨脚本和网络规避问题，并提供更好的监管审计合规性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出多模态AI原生制裁筛查的理论框架；2) 建立高维向量嵌入在实体解析中的应用理论；3) 发展AI裁决在模糊匹配中的理论模型；4) 构建活知识图谱的维护理论；5) 提出智能生命周期筛查的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为金融机构提供误报率显著降低的实用解决方案；2) 实现跨语言、跨脚本匹配能力；3) 提供网络规避检测机制；4) 改善监管审计合规性；5) 为行业提供可部署的AI原生筛查平台。

title: Labor Productivity Risk and Employment: A Bank-Capital Multiplier
affiliations: Humboldt University Berlin, Humboldt University of Berlin, Humboldt University of Berlin - School of Business and Economics, Auckland University of Technology and Johannes Kepler University Linz - Department of Economics

detail.title: Labor Productivity Risk and Employment: A Bank-Capital Multiplier
detail.abstract: How does employment respond to labor productivity risk? We analyze this response using data on small firms employing workers whose productivity depends on weather conditions. This allows us to measure effects of exogenous changes in labor productivity risk induced by weather risk. We document that the risk more strongly reduces firms' quasi-fixed employment in locations where regional banks have relatively little equity capital. Bank capitalization also affects banks' provision of liquidity "insurance" to firms facing losses due to transitory (weather-induced) productivity shocks. By providing this insurance, well-capitalized banks mitigate employment losses when labor productivity risk rises.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了劳动力生产率风险如何影响就业，发现银行资本充足率在缓解天气风险导致的就业损失中起关键作用
AI.research_question: 劳动力生产率风险如何影响就业？银行资本充足率在这一关系中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 理解劳动力生产率风险对就业的影响机制，特别是金融机构在缓解风险冲击中的作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力需求理论、银行资本约束理论、风险传导机制、流动性保险理论
AI.method: 利用小型企业数据，分析天气条件对工人生产率的影响，测量天气风险引起的外生劳动力生产率风险变化
AI.findings: 1) 劳动力生产率风险显著降低企业的准固定就业；2) 在地区银行资本相对较少的地方，这种影响更强；3) 资本充足的银行能为面临暂时性生产率冲击的企业提供流动性"保险"；4) 这种保险机制能缓解劳动力生产率风险上升时的就业损失

title: High-Frequency Monetary Policy Shocks: What are Markets Learning?

detail.title: High-Frequency Monetary Policy Shocks: What are Markets Learning?

declarations.funderStatement: Middlebury College

detail.abstract: Using tick-by-tick data for Federal Funds and Eurodollar futures, I document the high-frequency price discovery process following FOMC announcements. I find that price discovery often occurs almost instantaneously - frequently within seconds of the release - even for late-maturity futures, suggesting that mechanical arbitrage plays a significant role in determining futures prices around announcements. In contrast, announcements concerning unconventional policy, which typically require more intensive processing of qualitative language, exhibit a significantly more gradual price path - consistent with the idea that human interpretation operates on longer time scales. I reconstruct standard monetary policy shocks and show that shocks constructed using a narrow 15-second window are strongly correlated with those constructed over the conventional 20-minute window and carry similar economic content, further suggesting that mechanical price adjustment - rather than the gradual learning about policy information often assumed in the literature - accounts for much of what these shocks identify. If mechanical arbitrage shapes shock magnitudes, frictions that impede arbitrage should matter. Consistent with this, I find that measures of financial market stress (prior to announcements) explain a substantial share of the cross-meeting variation in shock magnitudes, with funding market conditions most important for target-rate shocks and interest rate uncertainty most important for path-factor shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文使用联邦基金利率和欧洲美元期货的逐笔数据，研究了FOMC公告后的高频价格发现过程。研究发现，价格发现通常在公告发布后几秒内几乎瞬时完成，表明机械套利在公告期间决定期货价格中起重要作用。相比之下，非常规政策公告需要更长时间处理定性语言，价格路径更为渐进。研究还发现，使用15秒窗口构建的货币政策冲击与传统的20分钟窗口构建的冲击高度相关，且金融压力指标能解释冲击幅度的跨会议变异。
AI.research_question: FOMC公告后的高频价格发现过程是如何进行的？机械套利在价格发现中扮演什么角色？金融摩擦如何影响货币政策冲击的幅度？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常假设市场参与者需要时间学习和处理政策信息，但本文作者观察到价格发现可能比预期更快，特别是在高频交易环境下。这种快速价格调整可能源于机械套利而非渐进学习，这一现象对理解货币政策传导机制有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格发现理论、套利理论、信息处理理论、货币政策传导机制理论。论文区分了机械套利驱动的快速价格调整与人类解释驱动的渐进价格调整两种机制。
AI.method: 使用联邦基金利率和欧洲美元期货的逐笔高频数据，分析FOMC公告后的价格发现过程。采用事件研究法，比较不同时间窗口（15秒vs20分钟）构建的货币政策冲击。使用回归分析检验金融压力指标对冲击幅度的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 常规货币政策公告后，价格发现几乎瞬时完成（通常在几秒内），即使是远期期货也是如此，表明机械套利起主导作用。2. 非常规政策公告需要更长时间处理定性语言，价格路径更为渐进。3. 15秒窗口构建的货币政策冲击与20分钟窗口构建的冲击高度相关且经济含义相似。4. 金融压力指标（特别是融资市场条件和利率不确定性）能解释货币政策冲击幅度的跨会议变异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了传统文献中关于市场需要时间学习政策信息的假设，提出机械套利是价格发现的主要驱动力。2. 区分了不同类型政策公告（常规vs非常规）的价格发现机制差异。3. 将金融摩擦纳入货币政策冲击分析框架，解释了冲击幅度的异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于市场如何快速吸收政策信息的实证证据。2. 揭示了金融压力如何影响货币政策传导效果，对金融稳定政策有启示。3. 为高频交易策略和风险管理提供了参考依据。4. 建议使用更短时间窗口构建货币政策冲击可能更准确反映市场即时反应。

detail.abstract:
This book studies economies as thermodynamic engines. It recasts the laws of thermodynamics into economic language. It also offers a new framework for understanding growth, instability, and collapse. Among modern economic theories, the ideas of Keynes and Minsky fit naturally into this framework. Minsky explains how an economic engine is driven too hard until it overheats and breaks. Keynes explains why stalled engines often fail to restart without an injection of external energy.

At the center of the analysis lies entropy: the universal tendency toward disorder, inefficiency, and decay. As entropy rises and overwhelms productive work, economic engines lose coordination. Workers grow discouraged. Institutions weaken. Decline begins. These ideas are applied to major episodes in economic history, including the Panic of 1873, the Great Depression, Detroit, California, the Roman Empire, Japan, the Soviet Union, and the United States. 

The book concludes by examining the fertility crisis and the unsettling possibility that even human civilization may sink into the quicksand of history.

AI.tldr: 这本书将经济系统重新概念化为热力学引擎，运用熵增定律解释经济增长、不稳定性和崩溃，将凯恩斯和明斯基的理论融入热力学框架，分析历史经济危机案例。
AI.research_question: 如何运用热力学原理（特别是熵增定律）来解释经济系统的增长、不稳定性和崩溃现象？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学理论在解释经济系统的动态变化、不稳定性和崩溃方面存在局限，需要新的跨学科框架来理解经济系统的本质运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学定律（特别是熵增定律）、凯恩斯经济学、明斯基金融不稳定假说、系统理论。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架构建，将热力学原理转化为经济语言，应用该框架分析历史经济案例（1873年恐慌、大萧条、底特律、加州、罗马帝国、日本、苏联、美国等）。
AI.findings: 经济系统作为热力学引擎，熵增导致无序、低效和衰退；经济过热类似于引擎超负荷运转；经济停滞需要外部能量注入才能重启；熵增导致经济协调性丧失、工人士气低落、制度弱化。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了经济系统的热力学分析框架，将物理学原理与经济理论相结合，为理解经济增长和崩溃提供了新的跨学科视角，整合了凯恩斯和明斯基的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解经济不稳定性的新工具，有助于识别经济过热和停滞的风险，对应对经济危机和制定复苏政策具有指导意义。

title: The Identity Threshold: A Cross-Disciplinary Framework for Understanding Why Revenue Is Leadership Autobiography

detail.title: The Identity Threshold: A Cross-Disciplinary Framework for Understanding Why Revenue Is Leadership Autobiography

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author provides B2B offering design, go-to-market strategy services, and business advisory for CEOs through Predictable Innovation Strategy. Observations from over 15 years advising C-suite leaders on high-stakes business decisions informed the development of this framework. The propositions and falsification criteria are designed to be testable independently of the author's involvement.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Identity Threshold — the developmental boundary where a leader's self-concept exhausts its capacity to generate organizational growth. The construct is universal: it constrains any organizational leader whose identity has fused with a role the organization has outgrown — startup founders, established business owners, practitioner-owners, family business successors, promoted-from-within executives, and tenured professional CEOs — varying in severity along an identity fusion spectrum anchored by psychological ownership theory (Pierce et al., 2001). Solo practitioner-owners and founders, whose identity is maximally fused with their value-creation role, face the highest threshold severity; externally hired CEOs face the lowest — but non-zero — severity that increases with tenure. Integrating seven previously disconnected literatures (identity-based motivation, possible selves, upper echelons, adult development, growth stages, professional identity transitions, and loss aversion / behavioral economics), the framework proposes that revenue plateaus at growth transitions are autobiographical markers — points where the leader's current self-concept must be reconstructed, not merely supplemented with new skills. Eight testable propositions with explicit falsification criteria connect leader identity variables to firm outcomes. The paper repositions the "founder's dilemma" as an identity problem rather than a governance problem, with implications for investors, boards, coaches, and leaders themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"身份阈值"概念，指领导者自我概念耗尽、无法推动组织增长的发展边界。该理论整合了七个不同文献领域，将创始人困境重新定位为身份问题而非治理问题。
AI.research_question: 领导者身份如何限制组织增长？身份阈值如何影响不同类型领导者的组织发展能力？
AI.motivation: 现有研究未能解释为什么许多组织在增长转型期停滞不前，即使领导者具备必要的技能。作者认为这源于领导者身份与组织角色的融合问题，需要从身份发展而非单纯技能补充的角度理解组织增长瓶颈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理所有权理论，整合七个文献领域：身份动机理论、可能自我理论、高层梯队理论、成人发展理论、增长阶段理论、职业身份转换理论、损失厌恶/行为经济学理论。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，提出包含八个可检验命题的概念框架，每个命题都有明确的证伪标准，将领导者身份变量与企业结果联系起来。
AI.findings: 收入增长平台期是自传性标记点，表明领导者当前的自我概念需要重构而非仅仅补充新技能。身份阈值严重程度沿身份融合光谱变化：个体执业者所有者和创始人的阈值最高，外部聘请CEO的阈值最低但非零，且随任期增加而增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"身份阈值"新构念；2) 整合七个先前不相关的文献领域；3) 将"创始人困境"重新定位为身份问题而非治理问题；4) 提供可检验的理论命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、董事会、教练和领导者自身提供实践启示：需要关注领导者的身份发展而非仅仅技能培训，在组织增长转型期支持领导者的自我概念重构。

title: Compliance Contagion: Market Exclusion Before Legal Determination

detail.title: Compliance Contagion: Market Exclusion Before Legal Determination

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
